DarnlinkAnchor.description: A typed UUID meaning "this element is identified here". Canonical RFC 4122 text form, lowercase only, any version. Exactly one element in a repository should carry a given anchor; a duplicate is the copier's responsibility, and darnlink reports links to it as ambiguous.
DarnlinkAnchor.title: DarnlinkAnchor

DarnlinkRef.description: A link to another element, with both halves of a robust Markdown link: the path or URL a reader follows, and the anchor of the target, the part that survives a move.

link.description: Where the target is: a path relative to the file that carries the reference, or an http(s) URL. Not an absolute path, not a bare #fragment, no other scheme.

DarnlinkRef.title: DarnlinkRef
